verifier_provenance.role: higher-capacity independent verification and reconciliation agent
verifier_provenance.agent: OpenAI Codex; runtime model identifier was not exposed to the agent
verifier_provenance.worktree_treatment: Existing uncommitted files were treated as parallel work. Only this reconciliation file was created.
verifier_provenance.authority_boundary: Evidence-bound technical and bibliographic questions were adjudicated. Institutionally content-changing work identity remains explicit and unresolved.

steps: The complete lane contract was read in state run before the artifact was created.
Both review files and all six draft/source inputs were loaded. Their case sets, selectors, exact slices, observed draft values and SHA-256 values were recomputed.
Source offsets were checked after universal-newline normalization to LF, matching the Python segmenter and both reviewers.
Each of the 76 cases was adjudicated against its exact source slice and the ratified work/edition model.
Technical segment boundaries, bibliographic fields, modeling depth and institutionally bound identity decisions were assessed separately.
A case was confirmed only when no unresolved uncertainty affected the accepted data.

disposition_legend.confirm: The current case is source-bound and model-conformant within the reviewed scope.
disposition_legend.correct: A deterministic field or affiliation correction is required before acceptance.
disposition_legend.reject-proposal: A reviewer escalation or proposed alternative is rejected because the source and ratified model determine the usable state.
disposition_legend.unresolved: The case requires authority that this verifier does not hold and must remain quarantined.

exact-match.criterion: Selector, slice hash, header, stable ID, year, publisher, location, page count and flags agree with the source and both independent checks.

source-exact-authority-normalization-def.criterion: The extracted value reproduces the source exactly. A normalized authority value must remain a separate, provenanced assertion.

double-header-two-editions.modeling_depth: two publication statements produce two edition nodes
double-header-two-editions.criterion: Each slash-delimited component has its own year, publisher and location. Shared block evidence may target both bodies while the component span remains recorded.

approximate-year-stable-id.bibliographic_fields: confirmed with yearRaw and uncertainty flag
approximate-year-stable-id.criterion: The ratified ID schema uses the source year. The circa qualifier is preserved in yearRaw and jahr-unsicher; the normalized 1965 anchor remains deterministic.

header-cleanup.modeling_depth: qualifier retained without inventing an unratified field
header-cleanup.criterion: Markup, series text or post-bold qualifiers are excluded from publisher and location while the raw header remains evidence.

page-count-repair.criterion: The source contains a narrow, recognizable page notation variant. The primary numbered-page value is retained and the raw notation remains evidence.

carrier-occurrence.modeling_depth: edition node retained and linked to carrier with schema:isPartOf
carrier-occurrence.institutional_authority: carrier detail may be deepened later
carrier-occurrence.criterion: The ratified model specifies schema:isPartOf from the edition to the carrier. Relation and edition node coexist, so the proposed either-or choice is rejected.

malformed-header-fields-clean.criterion: A missing closing bold marker does not contaminate the parsed values. The exact raw header remains available for provenance.

adaptation-work-identity.criterion: The source calls the item a graphic novel by Thomas Humeau and points to Le Joueur d'échecs [2015]. Rebinding changes work identity and remains quarantined pending authorized reconciliation.

review_integrity.provenance_finding: Both reviews are complete and internally traceable. Reviewer A uses zero-based edition_index and reviewer B uses one-based edition_index; edition_id is identical and canonical in every case.
limitations: The reviewer files hash the six paired data inputs. This reconciliation additionally hashes both reviewer files, the segmenter, the review specification, the model document, the lane contract and the local instruction file.
Reviewer dispositions are judgments. Matching hashes establish input identity and do not establish scholarly correctness by themselves.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: A header has a closed triple-apostrophe span followed by nonempty text on the same line.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Parse publisher and location only inside the closed span; preserve the tail as a raw qualifier or description with its source selector.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: Apply only when the bold span contains a complete year, publisher and location.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: No comma separates publisher and location inside the bold span, and a single period separates a publisher phrase ending in Verlag from a place phrase.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Split at that period; preserve the post-span bracket text as a qualifier.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: A location is followed by a terminal bracketed qualifier and the header lacks a closing bold marker.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Remove the bracketed qualifier from location, retain it as raw qualifier evidence and retain the original header.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: Apply only when the place prefix is independently recognized in the location vocabulary.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: A parsed location ends in unmatched closing wiki brackets.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Strip only the unmatched brackets from the normalized location and retain the exact header as evidence.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: Balanced link syntax is never changed by this rule.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: A slash is immediately followed by a bracketed year and both components contain a nonempty publisher and location.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Emit one edition node per component, preserve one shared physical block selector and record each component span as header evidence.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: Any incomplete component enters the review queue.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: yearRaw matches ca. plus a four-digit year.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Use the four-digit year in the stable ID, preserve yearRaw verbatim and add jahr-unsicher.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: The rule does not infer a year when the header contains no four-digit value.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: The first bounded page notation is exactly (N)p.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Set pageCount to N and retain the raw notation as field evidence.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: Carrier ranges written as pp. remain excluded.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: The first bounded page notation matches N/M)p. and the corpus convention N/(M)p. is otherwise established.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Set pageCount to N, retain the malformed raw notation and record the deterministic repair.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: Other malformed page strings enter the review queue.

automatic_implementation_rules.condition: The header lacks a closing bold marker while year, publisher and location parse without trailing markup or qualifier residue.
automatic_implementation_rules.action: Keep the parsed fields, retain the raw header and add a diagnostic malformed-header flag without escalating the bibliographic values.
automatic_implementation_rules.safety: Any field contamination is handled by the higher-priority cleanup rules or enters review.

competing_dispositions: Bind the 2016 book as an edition or translation of a distinct Humeau adaptation work.

unresolved_review_queue.verifier_finding: Edition retention and schema:isPartOf are resolved by the ratified model. Carrier detail remains a modeling-depth decision and does not block Gate 1 segmentation.

gate_1_full_run.reason: The 76-case review is reconciled, but the current segmenter still emits five contaminated header fields and misses two safely recoverable page counts. One work-identity case must be quarantined.
release_conditions: Implement the automatic rules in this artifact with focused regression tests.
Regenerate the three samples and verify all selectors, IDs, corrected fields, raw-header evidence and slice hashes.
Keep klawiter:edition/4916-2016-b out of confirmed workExample links until its authorized work binding is recorded.
Emit every future incomplete double-header component, unrecognized malformed header and unrecognized page notation into the canonical review queue.
Record deterministic repair provenance and retain source-exact values for every normalized field.
gate_1_full_run.full_run_policy: The full run may proceed after the deterministic rules and tests pass. The quarantined adaptation case remains visible and cannot be silently promoted.

summary.external_review_status: A later external expert review is additional validation and may revise the provenanced decisions. It is not a start condition for implementing the deterministic rules.
